name: RunnerGuard Basic Rules
description: A small deterministic rule set for initial development and testing.

rules.title: Required Mule project files must exist
rules.description: A Mule application should contain its main project descriptor files and source directory.
rules.message: The Mule project is missing one or more required files: {{ actual }}.
rules.recommendation: Restore the missing project descriptors or source directory before running validation.

rules.title: Flow and subflow names must use kebab-case
rules.description: Consistent names make flow references and reports easier to read.
rules.message: Flow '{{ flow.name }}' does not use kebab-case.
rules.recommendation: Use a lower-case name such as 'order-api-flow' or 'validate-order-subflow'.

rules.title: Flow should not contain too many components
rules.description: Very large flows are difficult to test, understand, and reuse.
rules.message: Flow '{{ flow.name }}' contains {{ actual }} components; the configured maximum is {{ expected }}.
rules.recommendation: Extract cohesive processing steps into named subflows.

rules.title: Flow references must resolve
rules.description: Every flow-ref must point to an existing flow or subflow.
rules.message: Flow '{{ flow.name }}' contains unresolved flow references: {{ actual }}.
rules.recommendation: Correct the flow-ref name or add the referenced flow/subflow.

rules.title: Executable flow should have an effective error handler
rules.description: A source-triggered flow should use either a local or configured default error handler.
rules.message: Flow '{{ flow.name }}' has a source but no effective error handler was detected.
rules.recommendation: Add a local error-handler or configure a project default error handler.

rules.title: HTTP listener port should use a property placeholder
rules.description: Environment-specific connection settings should not be hard-coded.
rules.message: HTTP listener port '{{ actual }}' is hard-coded.
rules.recommendation: Use a Mule property placeholder such as '${http.port}'.

rules.title: Logger message must not contain obvious secret literals
rules.description: Logger messages should not expose passwords, tokens, or API keys.
rules.message: Logger message may contain a secret literal.
rules.recommendation: Remove sensitive values from logs and log only safe identifiers.
